## Education

**Binghamton University, State University of New York**\
Bachelor of Mathematical Sciences in Statistics; Minor in Digital and
Data Studies\
Expected Graduation: June 2027 · GPA: **3.8**/4.0

## Research Interests

Biostatistics; artificial intelligence for health; bioinformatics;
statistical learning; cancer biomarker discovery; mental health
evaluation; mixed-methods research; reproducible data science;
interactive data visualization.

## Research Experience

::: cv-entry
[November 2025–Present]{.cv-date} [Chemo-Immunotherapy Biomarker
Discovery]{.cv-entry-title} — Independent Study, Binghamton University\
[Faculty Mentor: Dr. Nancy Guo]{.cv-mentor}

- Reproduce and validate single-cell RNA-seq preprocessing pipelines,

- Perform differential expression analysis and Gene Set Enrichment

  response; manuscript in preparation.

## Technical Projects

::: cv-entry
[January 2026–May 2026]{.cv-date} [Histopathology Thyroid Cancer
Detection Using YOLO]{.cv-entry-title} — Group Project, Binghamton
University

- Built a YOLO-based deep-learning model to detect thyroid cancer,
  abnormal, and normal tissue in histopathological images for potential
  pre-screening applications.
- Evaluated model performance through Type I and Type II error analysis,
  assessing risks of missed diagnoses and unnecessary follow-up.
- Interpreted confusion matrices to assess model limitations related to
  class imbalance and dataset representativeness.
:::

::: cv-entry
[September 2025–December 2025]{.cv-date} [Deep Reinforcement Learning in
Board Games]{.cv-entry-title} — Group Project, Binghamton University

- Implemented deep reinforcement-learning agents in PyTorch to play
  Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four through self-play.
- Designed neural networks mapping board states to action values and
  visualized training performance using Matplotlib.
:::
